# DandyEarth

> DandyEarth is an outsourced IT department for mission-driven organizations of about 5 to 50 people,
> serving the Central Valley of California (Modesto, Turlock, Stockton, Merced) and the Abilene /
> Clyde area of West Texas, plus remote clients. Core: managed IT. Secondary: websites and business AI.

## Services
- Managed IT Services: https://dandy.earth/services/managed-it/
- Cybersecurity & Email Protection: https://dandy.earth/services/cybersecurity/
- Microsoft 365 & Cloud: https://dandy.earth/services/microsoft-365-cloud/
- Servers, Networks & Infrastructure: https://dandy.earth/services/servers-networks/
- Backup & Disaster Recovery: https://dandy.earth/services/backup-recovery/
- Business AI & Automation (consulting and pilots): https://dandy.earth/services/business-ai/
- IT Consulting & Special Projects: https://dandy.earth/services/it-consulting/
